answer: The price is time: 4 years and 150 drill audits per identity, and time is the one thing a farm cannot print. What stops the farm is not the nectar alone but the quartz behind it and the wharf that survives every appeal. The gate asks for Storied quartermaster licence with quartermasters attestation before the first reward — a licence quartermasters renew after drill audits. A faker would have to earn all three from scratch.
